description: This file defines repository interfaces and their implementations for handling database operations related to customers, outages, and jobs within the outage management platform. It uses Dapper for data access and contains methods for CRUD operations, listing, and creating related entities with transaction support.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Implements customer data access methods, including fetching a customer by ID and searching customers within an organization.

classes.name: OutageRepository
classes.description: Handles outage-related data operations like retrieving, listing, creating, and updating outages, including associated location and outage updates.

classes.name: JobRepository
classes.description: Manages job entities, including creating, retrieving, listing, assigning, and updating job statuses, along with tracking status events.

methods.name: GetCustomerByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a customer by their ID, filtering by role 'customer'.

methods.name: SearchCustomersAsync
methods.description: Searches customers within an organization matching a query string with pagination.

methods.name: GetOutageAsync
methods.description: Retrieves outage details by outage ID.

methods.name: ListOutagesAsync
methods.description: Lists outages for an organization with optional status and severity filters, supporting pagination.

methods.name: CreateOutageAsync
methods.description: Creates a new outage record along with its location and initial update, in a transaction.

methods.name: UpdateOutageStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of an outage and logs the change.

methods.name: AddOutageUpdateAsync
methods.description: Adds an update message to an outage, recording the type and creator.

methods.name: GetOutageUpdatesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of updates for a specific outage.

methods.name: GetJobAsync
methods.description: Fetches details of a job by its ID.

methods.name: ListJobsAsync
methods.description: Lists jobs for an organization with optional status and outage filters, with pagination.

methods.name: CreateJobAsync
methods.description: Creates a new job and logs its creation event.

methods.name: AssignJobAsync
methods.description: Assigns a crew and user to a job, updating its status and recording the event.

methods.name: UpdateJobStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of a job and logs the change.

methods.name: GetJobStatusEventsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves status change events for a job.
